description: One key of Tape Keys on the Web Audio API: its tape runs on the track chosen for eight seconds at most, a little off in pitch and level, with hiss, wow and flutter, through saturation and a tone; noteOn runs a key, or cuts the held one and runs anew, noteOff lets the tape go at once, and the speed, wow and tone move a held key. A host plays chords with several.
name: tape-keys-engine
